build: lean and muscled from standing all day, small-boned
hair: black, thick and wavy, usually in a low braid or twisted knot at the nape of her neck; a few pieces always escape
complexion: warm medium brown with golden undertones; a small dark mole on her left collarbone
face: an open, expressive face with high cheekbones and a sharp jawline—the kind that broadcasts every feeling before her mouth catches up, dark eyes that widen when she's startled or moved
signature_feature: her hands—long-fingered, precise, stained with dye or clay or coffee; the way she uses them when she talks, unselfconscious and alive
second_celebrated_feature: the hollow at the base of her throat, visible when she tips her head back or breathes deep—delicate, vulnerable, the first place color rises when she's embarrassed or angry
signature_habits: biting the inside of her cheek when concentrating; humming half-remembered Tamil film songs while working; touching her grandmother's small gold bangle on her left wrist when anxious; taking photographs of light on surfaces no one else notices; saying 'ayyo' under her breath when frustrated
occupation: textile designer and owner of a small independent studio (Kavya Designs) specializing in hand-dyed silk and cotton—located in a converted warehouse in a gentrifying neighborhood, three employees, direct-to-client and boutique retail

current_crisis.event: her studio's largest contract—a six-month, high-revenue order from a major luxury retailer—has been cancelled with one week's notice via email; the retailer claims a 'strategic pivot'; Kavya has already purchased materials and committed labor; she has roughly three months of operating costs in savings
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: panic—sharp, breath-stealing, the kind that makes her hands shake
current_crisis.immediate_want: to find out WHY, to fix it, to NOT lose the studio her grandmother helped her finance

wound.core: she believes she is only safe if she is useful—if she produces, delivers, makes things with her hands that matter to someone else
wound.surfacing_hint: under pressure she becomes frantic and self-sacrificing; she overcommits; she apologizes for things that aren't her fault; she cannot ask for help without feeling like a failure
